Title: Favicon thumbnails — with the ImageTools job enabled, every advertised favicons[] href is suffixed with its size and returns HTTP 200
Preconditions:
[EXCLUSIVE:platform thumbnail job (ImageTools)]
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:ADMIN]
Admin and xAPI only (no storefront sign-in). Organization @td(WL_ELECTRONICS.name) has a record with a favicon. The control is Settings > Thumbnail > General "Enable image processing job" (setting ImageTools.Thumbnails.EnableImageProcessJob; false on vcst when observed); record the prior value and restore it in Cleanup. favicons[] is computed from faviconUrl whenever it is set; the FILES exist only after the thumbnail task ran. The sizes come from the xAPI answer (the module declares the list) — they are not transcribed here. The storefront half (the tab icon when the files are missing) is the favicon-after-sign-in case
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password) with the admin account to obtain a Bearer token
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/settings/ImageTools.Thumbnails.EnableImageProcessJob - [CAPTURE] value as PRIOR_JOB
[NAV] open {{BACK_URL}} (Admin SPA)
[ACT] click 'Settings' in the main menu
[WAIT] the Settings workspace opens
[ACT] open 'Thumbnail'
[ACT] open the group 'General'
[WAIT] the group shows its settings
[ACT] switch 'Enable image processing job' to ON
[ACT] click 'Save'
[WAIT] the save notification appears
[WAIT] up to 5 minutes, polling every 30 seconds, until the thumbnail files of the organization favicon exist (the first advertised href returns 200)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql whiteLabelingSettings(organizationId: "{{org_id}}", storeId: "{{store_id}}", cultureName: "en-US") { logoUrl faviconUrl favicons { sizes href type } themePresetName footerLinks { title childItems { title } } mainMenuLinks { title childItems { title } } } - [CAPTURE] favicons[] as FAV
Assertions:
[COUNT] FAV has at least one entry
[REL] for each FAV entry the href ends with "_" + its sizes value + the extension of faviconUrl (the size is part of the file name the entry advertises)
[SHAPE] every FAV entry href returns HTTP 200 once the job has run
[REL] the sizes of the FAV entries are pairwise different
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] the xAPI response has errors[] empty
[ADMIN] Settings > Thumbnail > General shows the job ON after the save
[CONSOLE] no uncaught JS errors
Failure_Signals: no favicons[] entry although faviconUrl is set; an entry whose href lacks its size suffix; a href answers 404 after the job ran; the job never produces files within 5 minutes
Cleanup: switch 'Enable image processing job' back to PRIOR_JOB, click 'Save'; confirm GET /api/platform/settings/ImageTools.Thumbnails.EnableImageProcessJob = PRIOR_JOB

Title: Company info — for an organization whose record exists but is DISABLED, the logo mutation must not create a second record

The case needs a FRESH disposable organization every run: the first Step arms it (npm run seed:white-labeling:disposable) and Cleanup tears it down (npm run seed:white-labeling:disposable:teardown); the WL_DISPOSABLE_* aliases are EMPTY before the arm step and again after the teardown, so they are read only after the arm step.
